summary: I checked judge fix r1 (commit 8977798), which changes only 9 justification strings in tests/golden/postflop-spots.json. It changes no cards, actions or code. I re-ran the evaluator dump on all 120 spots. All 9 rewordings match the evaluator. t9s: one-pair, fives with K-T-9. q8o: one-pair, nines with Q-8-4. a3o: one-pair, jacks with an ace kicker, and no flush or straight draw on the turn. a2s: one-pair, eights with an ace kicker. k9s turn: high-card A-K-Q-9-8, and there is really no draw: no club on the board and no one-card straight. fr jts: high-card with the Ks playing, and on the turn only 3 clubs, so 'no draw' holds. hu t8o: one-pair jacks with a ten kicker, and 8-9-T-J on the turn was a real open-ended draw. hu t7s: high-card with the K playing; on the turn it had four hearts and 7-8-9-T, so both missed-draw claims hold, and the river Q makes no straight. fr aks: one-pair deuces with A-K kickers, and no straight because there is no 4. The exhaustive pass holds too. Every remaining justification that names the hero's high card (a9o x2, q9o, k9s flop, co-fold-a2s, k3s, a7s, k4o, a6o) is high-card with the hero's card the highest in play. The draw claims there (gutshot to J, gutshot to 4, no draw) are correct. J-1-02 dispute: the builder is right. With Ah 9c on 8d Qd 4h there are only two hearts (Ah, 4h), and there is no diamond in the hand, so there is no backdoor flush draw. The backdoor straight claim (8-9-Q needs T and J) is accurate. Golden tests: 288 of 288 pass. No new findings. The two NITs from round 2 carry forward.
